titleEnglish: Be Khud Kiye Dete Hain — Traditional

verses.ar:
Bekhud kiye dete hain andaaz hijaabana
Aa dil mein tujhe rakh lun ay jalwa e janana
verses.en:
Your veiled manner drives me beyond myself into ecstasy
Come, let me place you within my heart, O radiant beloved

verses.ar:
Mai ne masoom baharo me tumhe dekha hai
Mai ne pur noor sitaro me tumhe dekha hai
Mere mehboob teri parda nashini ki qasam
Mai ne ashko ki qataroo me tumhe dekha hai
verses.en:
I have seen you in the innocent blossoms of spring
I have seen you in the luminous stars
I swear by the unveiling of your face, my beloved
I have seen you in the streams of my tears

verses.ar:
Bekhud kiye dete hain andaaz hijaabana
Aa dil mein tujhe rakh lun ay jalwa e janana
verses.en:
Your veiled manner drives me beyond myself into ecstasy
Come, let me place you within my heart, O radiant beloved

verses.ar:
Kyun aankh milayi thi kyun aag lagai thi
Ab rukh ko chupa bethe karke mujhe deewaana
verses.en:
Why did you meet my eyes — why did you ignite that fire?
Now you hide your face, having made me utterly mad

verses.ar:
Ji chahta hai tohfe mein bhejun unhein ankhein
Darshan ka to darshan ho nazrane ka nazrana
verses.en:
My heart desires to send them my very eyes as a gift
That the gift of beholding be itself a tribute to beholding

verses.ar:
Peene ko to pee lunga bas arz zara si hai
Ajmer ka saaqi ho bagdaad ka mekhaana
verses.en:
I will drink, I only have one small request
Let the cup-bearer be from Ajmer and the tavern from Baghdad

verses.ar:
Dunya mein hamein tumne jab apna banaya hai
Mehshar mein bhi keh dena ye hai mera deewaana
verses.en:
Since in this world you have made me your own
On the Day of Judgement too, declare: this one is my devoted one
